id.description: Unique identifier for the checkbox input

name.description: Name attribute for the checkbox input, used for form submission

value.description: Value attribute for the checkbox input

description.description: Optional description text that provides additional information about the checkbox

tile.description: Whether to use the tile checkbox style

small.description: Whether to use the small checkbox style

error.description: Error message to display when the checkbox is in an error state

success.description: Success message to display when the checkbox is in a success state

className.description: Additional classes to add to the checkbox container

onChange.description: Function called when the checkbox value changes (React) or JavaScript code string for onchange attribute (Django)

required.description: Whether the checkbox is required, adds asterisk to label and required attribute to input
